notes.title: Huge Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224870/1a59377f36fe2b1f69135cbe3c5c423751fc1b85.png[/img]
Hey there! We've prepared some significant changes to enhance and diversify your gaming experience.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

1. The item drop interval has been changed from 2 hours to 90 minutes.

2. Drop rates for different item rarities have been adjusted:
[list]
[*] Common items now have a 77% drop rate.
[*] Rare items now have a 20% drop rate.
[*] Legendary items now have a 3% drop rate.
[/list]
We hope these changes will help you dive back into Waifu Closet!

Stay tuned — there’s a lot more exciting stuff coming soon. And while you're here, we'd love to introduce you to our new project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218710?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=WaifuCloset&utm_campaign=Post2VisibilityRound

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.content:
Dear players, we are pleased to announce the update we have prepared for the Waifu Closet. 

The gift delivery time has been shortened: now 1 item will drop every 2 hours instead of 3 hours

Your clicks (hearts) will be saved between sessions. You no longer have to worry about resetting your progress. Your waifu will remember everything you've done for her and will look forward to your return!

We'd also like to reveal the probability of rare items dropping:
[list]
[*] 2% on rare items;
[*] 18% for unusual items;
[*] 80% for common items
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Inventory Issues
notes.content:
Dear players, we are aware of the issue with items from our game not appearing in your Steam inventories. Our development team is actively working on a solution, and we appreciate your patience as we address this.

In the meantime, stay close to your waifus—they're here to keep you company!
